summary:

Work shifted to webhook reliability: `WebhookSender` now accepts configurable attempts, validates at least one attempt, retries transport errors and retryable server errors with bounded backoff, and re-raises exhausted transport failures. Router splitting is paused. The newly reported high-priority issue—dunning reminders emailing customers who already paid—has not yet been investigated or fixed. Reconcile webhook retries with the earlier warning about duplicate customer emails before proceeding.

Worker tests had 14 passing after the fix, with debugging confirming expected pending-event lengths.
